key.name: bar-height
key.description: Height of the top bar in pixels.

key.name: floating-bar
key.description: Make the top bar floating with rounded corners and margins.

key.name: bar-blur
key.description: Apply background blur effect to the top bar.

key.name: bar-blur-radius
key.description: Radius for the background blur effect.

key.name: autohide-in-fullscreen-or-maximized
key.summary: Auto-hide with fullscreen or maximized windows
key.description: Automatically hide the top bar when a window is maximized or fullscreen, revealing it on mouse hover at the top edge.

key.name: show-system-menu
key.description: Show Fedora logo button on the left with shutdown/settings options.

key.name: show-active-app
key.description: Show the name of the active application.

key.name: show-clock
key.description: Show clock in the right corner with calendar integration.

key.name: clock-format
key.description: Strftime format for the top bar clock.

key.name: show-spotlight
key.description: Show search icon to trigger file and app search.

key.name: show-wifi
key.description: Show Wi-Fi status indicator and quick access.

key.name: show-bluetooth
key.description: Show Bluetooth status indicator and quick access.

key.name: show-volume
key.description: Show volume status indicator and quick access menu.

key.name: show-battery
key.description: Show battery icon and percentage.

key.name: show-notifications
key.description: Show notification icon to view and manage recent notifications.

key.name: show-control-center
key.description: Show sliders icon to trigger GNOME Quick Settings.

key.name: show-settings-btn
key.description: Show gear icon to open Wave Top Bar preferences.

key.name: bar-opacity
key.description: Opacity percentage (0 to 100) of the top bar background.

key.name: bar-color
key.description: Theme: 'auto', 'dark', 'light', 'black', or 'custom'.

key.name: bar-custom-color
key.description: Hex color code when bar-color is custom.
